slides.title: Data from real people
slides.text: Today the data comes from real people: you and the people around you. Collecting it well is half the job.
slides.alt: The class survey begins: one stepper per answer, Dog 3 and Cat 2 so far, and Dot explains how to tally, chart and claim.

focus.cue: One tap on plus for every answer

slides.title: One mark per answer
slides.text: A survey asks people one question. Each answer gets one mark: on paper a tally mark, counted in fives, four lines then one across. In the game, one tap on plus.
slides.alt: The survey tallied: Dog 12, Cat 3, Fish 4, Bird 0, Rabbit 0, None 2. One mark for every answer.

focus.cue: Every pet gets its own count

slides.title: From tally to chart
slides.text: Put the counts in a bar chart with one bar per answer. The tallest bar jumps out fast.
slides.alt: The same tally as a bar chart: Dog 12 towers over Cat 3, Fish 4 and None 2.

slides.title: Fair claims
slides.text: A fair claim says only what the chart shows, about the people you asked. Dogs are the favorite pet in our class is fair. Dogs are everyone's favorite is not.
slides.alt: The claim card for the pet chart: most kids picked Dog; fewest picked Bird; more than half picked Dog; Dog and Fish tied.

focus.cue: Fair: most kids in our class picked Dog
Fewest picked Bird? Rabbit got 0 too

slides.title: Ask someone else
slides.text: Show your claim to someone else and ask: is it fair? Dot does the same: she asks you to show the bar that proves it.
slides.alt: A claim is pinned, and Dot asks for proof: now show me, tap the bar that proves it.

focus.cue: Dot asks: show me the proof
Tap the bar that proves it

words.means: asking many people the same question
one kind of answer, like dog or cat
something the data says is true

slides.title: Dot's piece lights up
slides.text: Dot's piece clicks into place: two of four, and the Spark glows a little brighter. Next, Pim the owl is waiting at the post office, with a town full of letters to deliver.

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Data Detective at My Data. Chart both survey questions with the steppers. Pin one claim, then ask someone if it is fair.
slides.alt: The class survey begins: one stepper per answer, Dog 3 and Cat 2 so far, and Dot explains how to tally, chart and claim.

focus.cue: Tally each answer with the steppers
Then chart it and pin one fair claim
